---
name: Risk
about: A risk found while auditing the codebase (security, data loss, correctness) that needs verification
title: "[Risk] "
labels: risk
assignees: ''
---

## Risk description

What is the risk? Describe it concretely, not just "this might be a problem."

## Impact if it happens

What's actually at stake — money, data, security, or user experience?

## How to verify

What would prove this risk is real (or prove it isn't)? A reproduction
step, a query, a test.

## Related curriculum stage

Which stage (0–6) of the engineering log does this relate to, if any?

## Verification status

- [ ] Not yet checked
- [ ] Confirmed real
- [ ] Confirmed safe (verified, not an actual risk)
